description: Karnataka vs Tamil Nadu, five rounds of official data. Final score: Tamil Nadu 3, Karnataka 2.

Power available per person: Karnataka 1,357.3, Tamil Nadu 1,691.7 (Tamil Nadu ahead; kWh a year · 2024-25 · higher is better)
Villages with 5G: Karnataka 65.8%, Tamil Nadu 56.9% (Karnataka ahead; % of villages · 28 Feb 2026 · higher is better)
Power lost in the wires: Karnataka 16.3%, Tamil Nadu 15.3% (Tamil Nadu ahead; % lost in transmission and distribution · 2022-23 · lower is better)
Groundwater drawn each year: Karnataka 66.5%, Tamil Nadu 73.5% (Karnataka ahead; % of the yearly extractable amount · 2025 · lower is better)
Electricity generated per person: Karnataka 1,461.7, Tamil Nadu 1,683.0 (Tamil Nadu ahead; kWh a year · 2024-25 · higher is better)

Closing map: Villages with 5G, every state (Tamil Nadu 3 · Karnataka 2 · India 57.0%). Share of villages (Registrar General's list) where 5G service has been brought, 28 Feb 2026: not share of people. Both states outlined.
